description:
In Episode 245 we discuss the war with Iran. The media is ablaze with different rhetorics, the blame game is raging as to why it started, and even within political parties people are at each other’s throats. But as always, we try to look from a bird’s eye view at the situation and not get sucked into the quagmire. Is there any Biblical significance to this war and what could be the possible goal?
